g.text: -? for the number of VPs in the box containing the Rising Sun VP marker, if Total War is in effect.
-1 if the Axis War Production marker is in the Strategic Warfare Box.
Use the Port-to-Port procedure to move to/from a port in the West Indian Ocean Naval Zone.
Use the Off-Map Box to Off-Map Box procedure to move to/from the Panama Canal Box.
Replacement Location for British non-colonial and Afr colonial units.
North: Aleutian Islands, Japan, Korea, Manchukuo, Russia
Desert: Sinkiang, Mongolia, Tibet Central: Formosa, Hong Kong, Kiangsu, Kwangtung, Yunnan
North Monsoon: Burma, Ceylon, India, Indochina, Malaya, Nepal, Philippines, Siam
South Monsoon: Netherlands East Indies, New Guinea South: Australia, New Zealand
